findings.summary: The contract requires publishing an external acceptance-run result and a B40 HTTP-503 diagnosis that are not established by repository-contained evidence, and the proposed real-data gate expressly cannot check them.
findings.evidence: D6 requires 10 of 10 URL-shortener tasks, all first-pass, about $1.31, and every session kind, but says its metrics are in an acceptance repository outside this repository and that no session here checks them. The Shape task 1 gate reads only B40-B44 metrics plus B39's run record. For the separate HTTP-503 claim, B40's .vloop/state/runs/B20261125-2207-b40-i156-mixed-os-pwsh/20261125-230701/run.log records a failed work session with no attempt charged, and sessions/011-work.json records is_error=true, but neither records HTTP 503 or proves the endpoint cause. docs/design-notes/copilot-cli-experiments.md is cited as a binding reference but does not yet contain the new evidence; the task must create it from the unsupported literals.
findings.fix: Operator decision required: either provide a durable repository-contained source for the URL-shortener metrics and the 503 cause, cite that source in the brief, and gate the required literals against it; or remove those externally sourced details and scope D3/D6 to the B40-B44 facts that the in-repo metrics and kept brief-review records prove.
